name: Nakigara no Tori
source:
A race of beings who live by consuming the love of other people, called "Shichou". It is said that they have the power to grant any wish of their master, in return for love. 

"Shichou don't love people, they just devour their love." 

A fantasy story about love, hated, confusion, and those who seek intangible love.
translation:
靠消耗他人的爱而生存的种族，被称为“食仇”。据说，它们有能力满足主人的任何愿望，以换取爱。

“石丑不爱人，只会吞噬人的爱。” 

一个关于爱、恨、困惑以及那些寻求无形之爱的人的奇幻故事。
